# goslop text fixture — ValueError pass after pure int() conversion continues with stream measure (parva-mcp client)
lang: python
file: parva_mcp_server/client.py
---
def _read_bounded(response, maximum):
    declared = response.headers.get("content-length")
    if declared:
        try:
            if int(declared) > maximum:
                raise RuntimeError("response too large")
        except ValueError:
            pass
    chunks = []
    total = 0
    for chunk in response.iter_bytes():
        total += len(chunk)
        if total > maximum:
            raise RuntimeError("response too large")
        chunks.append(chunk)
    return b"".join(chunks)
